# Quick Capture text fixtures

Synthetic samples that imitate the *shape* of text a user gets when they select
and copy a job page in their own browser (nav chrome, header strip, JD body,
福利 / 相似职位 / HR trailers).

They are hand-written for this repository. No fixture is a copy of a real page,
and every company, recruiter and vacancy in them is invented. Nothing here is
fetched from a live site.
